integration_environment: Use integration own verified companion/config paths; do not reuse stale ara-pr169 paths or modify another unit project.

rt_map_residency.existing: RT atmosphere uses TLAS rays. Virtual-shadow buffers/injection are selected only when hardware_shadows is absent; no maintained RT VSM page set is available for free reuse.
rt_map_residency.B: Dedicated coarse 1024x1024 sun-only fog map covering froxel range, redrawn every admitted frame, including camera motion/cuts. Approximately 4 MiB per view plus uniform/record.
rt_map_residency.shared_vsm_row: Not implemented or timed; maintaining VSM solely for fog would require a separate variant and account for all page rendering/update cost.

lease_budget.rule: Checkpoint every completed case. Default one capture per lease. Only pack a second after measured current-head time plus startup leaves at least 24 seconds before the 204-second deadline. Never queue the entire matrix as one child.
lease_budget.campaign: Two interleaved/reversed rounds across bounded leases; all eight cases per path cannot honestly fit one child deadline at observed runtime. Retain both rounds; do not silently shorten warm-up, motion or cut coverage.

cost_reporting: Per case/view report medians and cut0/cut1/cut2 separately: injection, atmosphere.shadow_map upkeep, their per-frame sum, complete atmosphere and whole GPU span. Report B upkeep even if injection is faster; do not substitute injection for total B cost. Both numbers unmeasured until integration runs complete.
C_limit: Quarter tracing is a candidate, not a promised quarter total cost or identical still result. Reprojection/temporal/integration remain full cost. Full trace on cut/sun/caster/medium reset and invalid history; inspect shaft lag and first cut frames before any default decision.
